Sources

Where your genre data comes from, and how to fill the gaps.

How this works

Spotify provides no genre data, so tags come from Last.fm. This page ships a prebuilt set covering many artists; the sources below fill in the rest, into this device only. A Last.fm tag always wins; Wikidata and Discogs only ever fill an artist with no tags at all. To fix an artist that has tags but has them wrong, tap Wrong tags? under it on a Tidy or File row.

Of all the tag weight across your library, 90% describes a sound — the rest is moods, decades, occasions and things like nationality, which are not counted as evidence of genre.

9 of 10 artists have genre tags (90%).
